definition: Reviewed finite static visual controls. Enum values are illustrated through explicit profiles, not the full cross product. Native validation required before publication. 27 unresolved source-data profiles omitted; no substituted colors.

profilePolicy.Button: Every intent/emphasis/state at medium size and medium rounding; all size/rounding/aspect/state combinations for default intent and strong emphasis.
profilePolicy.Link: Every color or on-container color × underline × state at medium/regular; every size × weight at primary/auto/default (and secondary container for on-container profile).
profilePolicy.Badge: Every variant/emphasis/state at default size; every variant/emphasis at small/default state.
profilePolicy.TextInput: Every status/mode at baseline text/no slots; every slot/content combination at neutral/default.
profilePolicy.Textarea: Every status/mode at baseline text/no slots/clearable=false; every slot/content/clearable combination at default/default.

families.name: Button
contentProperties: All text layers expose editable TEXT properties.
All native icon instances expose INSTANCE_SWAP and BOOLEAN visibility properties.
omissions: Full-width behavior is native frame resizing; square aspect swaps text content for a native icon. CSS forced-colors media mode is represented by the browser, not this light/dark library.

families.name: Slider
contentProperties: All text layers expose editable TEXT properties.
All native icon instances expose INSTANCE_SWAP and BOOLEAN visibility properties.
omissions: Values are sample stops within the source continuous range. Drag thumb positions and resize filled track for arbitrary values; min/max/step remain runtime constraints. Active pointer thumb shadow outline requires native visual QA.

families.name: SegmentedControl
contentProperties: All text layers expose editable TEXT properties.
All native icon instances expose INSTANCE_SWAP and BOOLEAN visibility properties.
omissions: Hug-width controls can resize natively; item count is arbitrary through duplication. Responsive label clamp is represented at the 16px maximum.

families.name: SplitButton
contentProperties: All text layers expose editable TEXT properties.
All native icon instances expose INSTANCE_SWAP and BOOLEAN visibility properties.
omissions: Content and menu trigger are separate native controls; dropdown menu composition is provided by Dropdown assets.

families.name: Notice
contentProperties: All text layers expose editable TEXT properties.
All native icon instances expose INSTANCE_SWAP and BOOLEAN visibility properties.
omissions: Message/action text and leading/dismiss icon visibility are native properties. Arbitrary custom React action content is composed with the other native control assets. Forced-colors media rendering remains in CSS.
